input: Draft a LinkedIn recommendation for a colleague

gold.taskTitle: Draft a LinkedIn Recommendation for a Colleague
gold.taskDescription: Write a compelling LinkedIn recommendation for a colleague that highlights their strengths and professional contributions.

questions.title: What is your colleague's full name and current job title?
questions.description: Identify the specific person the recommendation is being written for.

questions.title: What was your working relationship with this person?
questions.description: Clarify how the user knows the colleague, such as direct report, peer, or manager.

questions.title: What role or project should the recommendation focus on?
questions.description: Determine the specific context, position, or collaboration the recommendation should highlight.

questions.title: What are two or three of their strongest professional skills?
questions.description: Identify the key strengths or competencies to emphasize in the recommendation.

questions.title: Can you share one specific achievement or impact they had?
questions.description: Gather a concrete example or result that demonstrates the colleague's value.

questions.title: What tone should the recommendation have, formal or warm?
questions.description: Understand the desired voice and style for the final written piece.

questions.title: Is there a particular role or audience this recommendation targets?
questions.description: Determine if the recommendation should be tailored toward a specific industry, role type, or career goal.
